errors.text_span: Графиката илюстрира разпределението на работодателите по дял на запазените работни места по мярката 60/40 за периода март 2020 г. – юни 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description's first sentence is taken from the figure's caption, which is external to the chart image itself. The description should state the chart's purpose based on its visible elements like the axes.
The x-axis label in the figure is 'Работодатели - кумулативна относителна честота (%)'. The description omits the word 'относителна' (relative).
The y-axis label in the figure is 'Запазени работни места - кумулативна относителна честота (%)'. The description omits the word 'относителна' (relative).
At 10% on the x-axis, the line reaches a value of approximately 60% on the y-axis, not 50%.
The phrase 'Между 10% и 30% по оста X... достига около 80%' is inaccurate. At 30% on the x-axis, the value is approximately 85-87%. The value of 80% is reached at around 20% on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: достига до около 92% по оста Y при 100% по оста X
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in two ways. First, the final y-value of the cumulative frequency is 100%, not 92%. Second, the data line does not extend to 100% on the x-axis; it ends at approximately 95%.

errors.text_span: се изменя по оста X от 0% до 100%
errors.evidence: The data line does not extend to 100% on the x-axis. It stops at approximately 95%. Stating that it varies from 0% to 100% is an over-generalization of the data's range.
